title: 高速光模組電磁相容性
titleEn: Electromagnetic compatibility of high-speed optical modules
summary: 從發射源、耦合路徑、接收端與可重現測試拆成 4 階段、24 項可保存的工程作業；包含物理模型、算例、可區分失效的量測與驗收證據。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 saveable work packages investigate emission sources, coupling paths, victims and reproducible tests, including physical models, a worked example, discriminating measurements and acceptance evidence.
scope: 公開原理的概念設計與資料判讀課，非供應商配方或可直接投產的操作程序。算例全部是教學假設；真正驗收須使用適用版本、合格設備與實測參數。代表照片、示意圖與影片不宣稱為每步製造實拍。
scopeEn: Conceptual design and data interpretation from public principles, not a vendor recipe or production-ready procedure. All worked inputs are educational assumptions. Real acceptance requires the applicable revision, qualified equipment and measured parameters. Representative media are not claimed as footage of every operation.

stages.title: 標準範圍與返回路
stages.description: 以三個技術單元檢查「標準範圍與返回路」，每一單元交付設計模型及獨立判別證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Three technical units examine standard scope and returns, each delivering a model and independent diagnostic evidence.

steps.title: 範圍界定：模型與設計
steps.objective: 以「範圍界定」建立可檢驗的物理模型，交付可重算且列明邊界的工程紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Build a falsifiable physical model for scope definition, with reproducible calculations and stated boundaries.
steps.instruction: 先以師傅示意確認「範圍界定」的輸入、輸出與座標，再在學徒工作台完成對應元件或資料流的排列。光模組的電磁測試需按設備用途和適用標準決定，不能從名稱直接選限值。 用本單元的變數畫出至少兩種設計狀態，說明它們在「建立用途、端口、環境與標準版本表，由合格實驗室確認適用性。」的驗證中應有何差異；把待量測參數另列，不以動畫位置當成實際公差。
steps.instructionEn: Use the mentor view to identify the inputs, outputs and coordinates for scope definition, then arrange the corresponding components or data flow in the apprentice workspace. EMC testing depends on equipment use and applicable standards, not the optical-module label. Draw at least two design states using this unit's variables and predict how the following verification distinguishes them: Document use, ports, environment and standard revision for qualified applicability review. List unmeasured parameters separately; animation positions are not manufacturing tolerances.
steps.observation: 建立用途、端口、環境與標準版本表，由合格實驗室確認適用性。
steps.observationEn: Document use, ports, environment and standard revision for qualified applicability review.
steps.failure: 須排除的錯誤假說：光纖傳資料就完全沒有電磁發射。 若觀察不支持預測，先核對基準與單位，再依本步判別量測定位原因；不能只調參到曲線相合。
steps.failureEn: Incorrect hypothesis to reject: Optical data transmission eliminates electromagnetic emissions. If observations disagree, first check references and units, then use this step's discriminating measurement; do not simply tune parameters until curves agree.
steps.check: 提交範圍界定的兩狀態模型、變數表，以及能由「建立用途、端口、環境與標準版本表，由合格實驗室確認適用性。」反駁模型的預測。
steps.checkEn: Submit two model states and a variable table for scope definition, plus a falsifiable prediction using: Document use, ports, environment and standard revision for qualified applicability review.

knowledge.title: 量化模型與適用邊界
knowledge.text: VdBµV=20log10(V/1µV)；有阻抗才可由 P=V²/R 轉換功率。 假設同一量測阻抗、檢波器與帶寬；正式測試依適用標準和校正配置。
knowledge.textEn: VdBµV=20log10(V/1µV); power conversion P=V²/R requires impedance. Assume matched impedance, detector and bandwidth; formal testing follows applicable standards and calibrated setup.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「高速光模組電磁相容性」的「範圍界定：模型與設計」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出晶粒、基板、接點與量測端的介面，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「熱島救援：模組交付前夜」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與批號、接合位置、熱歷史、接點讀值與顯微圖版本的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Scope definition: model and design” in “Electromagnetic compatibility of high-speed optical modules”. Draw the die, substrate, joint and measurement interfaces; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Thermal Island: Before Module Delivery” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for lot, joint location, thermal history, contact readings and micrograph version, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.question: 要審查「範圍界定」，哪項主張或驗證方法有根據？
quiz.questionEn: Which claim or verification is justified when reviewing scope definition?
options: 光模組的電磁測試需按設備用途和適用標準決定，不能從名稱直接選限值。
光纖傳資料就完全沒有電磁發射。
近場掃描可直接當任何標準的合格證明。
optionsEn: EMC testing depends on equipment use and applicable standards, not the optical-module label.
Optical data transmission eliminates electromagnetic emissions.
Near-field scans prove compliance with any standard.
quiz.explanation: 光模組的電磁測試需按設備用途和適用標準決定，不能從名稱直接選限值。 建立用途、端口、環境與標準版本表，由合格實驗室確認適用性。
quiz.explanationEn: EMC testing depends on equipment use and applicable standards, not the optical-module label. Document use, ports, environment and standard revision for qualified applicability review.

steps.title: 範圍界定：量測與判別
steps.objective: 以「範圍界定」區分機制並作出有證據的驗收決定，交付可重算且列明邊界的工程紀錄。

steps.instruction: 保留上一作業的模型，現在檢驗它是否足以解釋觀察。建立用途、端口、環境與標準版本表，由合格實驗室確認適用性。 記錄原始量、單位、基準與重複量測差異；以支持及否定各一項證據比較「光模組的電磁測試需按設備用途和適用標準決定，不能從名稱直接選限值。」與錯誤假說「近場掃描可直接當任何標準的合格證明。」，最後提出放行、重測或修模決定。
steps.instructionEn: Retain the previous model and test whether it explains the observations. Document use, ports, environment and standard revision for qualified applicability review. Record raw quantities, units, reference conditions and repeatability. Use supporting and falsifying evidence to compare "EMC testing depends on equipment use and applicable standards, not the optical-module label." against the incorrect hypothesis "Near-field scans prove compliance with any standard."; decide whether to accept, repeat or revise the model.
steps.observation: 建立用途、端口、環境與標準版本表，由合格實驗室確認適用性。
steps.observationEn: Document use, ports, environment and standard revision for qualified applicability review.
steps.failure: 須排除的錯誤假說：近場掃描可直接當任何標準的合格證明。 若觀察不支持預測，先核對基準與單位，再依本步判別量測定位原因；不能只調參到曲線相合。
steps.failureEn: Incorrect hypothesis to reject: Near-field scans prove compliance with any standard. If observations disagree, first check references and units, then use this step's discriminating measurement; do not simply tune parameters until curves agree.
steps.check: 提交範圍界定的量測判別表：建立用途、端口、環境與標準版本表，由合格實驗室確認適用性。 附上基準、重複性或不確定度，及不能由本資料判定的結論。

steps.objectiveEn: Build a falsifiable physical model for return paths, with reproducible calculations and stated boundaries.
steps.instruction: 先以師傅示意確認「返回路徑」的輸入、輸出與座標，再在學徒工作台完成對應元件或資料流的排列。參考平面中斷迫使返回電流繞路，提高環路面積與耦合。 用本單元的變數畫出至少兩種設計狀態，說明它們在「標出跨平面走線、回流過孔與屏蔽接點，與近場掃描對照。」的驗證中應有何差異；把待量測參數另列，不以動畫位置當成實際公差。 教學接收電壓 100 µV 對 1 µV 基準為 20log10(100)=40 dBµV；降到 20 µV 為 26.02 dBµV，降低 13.98 dB。若纜線損失 2 dB 且需回推源端，應加 2 dB。這些數字不是任何標準的合格限值。
steps.instructionEn: Use the mentor view to identify the inputs, outputs and coordinates for return paths, then arrange the corresponding components or data flow in the apprentice workspace. Broken reference planes force return-current detours and increase loop area/coupling. Draw at least two design states using this unit's variables and predict how the following verification distinguishes them: Map plane crossings, return vias and shield contacts against near-field scans. List unmeasured parameters separately; animation positions are not manufacturing tolerances. A teaching receiver voltage of 100 µV is 40 dBµV; 20 µV is 26.02 dBµV, a 13.98 dB reduction. Add a 2 dB cable loss when referring back to the source. These are not acceptance limits from a standard.

steps.title: 返回路徑：量測與判別
steps.objective: 以「返回路徑」區分機制並作出有證據的驗收決定，交付可重算且列明邊界的工程紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Discriminate mechanisms and make an evidence-based acceptance decision for return paths, with reproducible calculations and stated boundaries.
steps.instruction: 保留上一作業的模型，現在檢驗它是否足以解釋觀察。標出跨平面走線、回流過孔與屏蔽接點，與近場掃描對照。 記錄原始量、單位、基準與重複量測差異；以支持及否定各一項證據比較「參考平面中斷迫使返回電流繞路，提高環路面積與耦合。」與錯誤假說「光纖傳資料就完全沒有電磁發射。」，最後提出放行、重測或修模決定。 教學接收電壓 100 µV 對 1 µV 基準為 20log10(100)=40 dBµV；降到 20 µV 為 26.02 dBµV，降低 13.98 dB。若纜線損失 2 dB 且需回推源端，應加 2 dB。這些數字不是任何標準的合格限值。
steps.instructionEn: Retain the previous model and test whether it explains the observations. Map plane crossings, return vias and shield contacts against near-field scans. Record raw quantities, units, reference conditions and repeatability. Use supporting and falsifying evidence to compare "Broken reference planes force return-current detours and increase loop area/coupling." against the incorrect hypothesis "Optical data transmission eliminates electromagnetic emissions."; decide whether to accept, repeat or revise the model. A teaching receiver voltage of 100 µV is 40 dBµV; 20 µV is 26.02 dBµV, a 13.98 dB reduction. Add a 2 dB cable loss when referring back to the source. These are not acceptance limits from a standard.
steps.observation: 標出跨平面走線、回流過孔與屏蔽接點，與近場掃描對照。
steps.observationEn: Map plane crossings, return vias and shield contacts against near-field scans.
steps.failure: 須排除的錯誤假說：光纖傳資料就完全沒有電磁發射。 若觀察不支持預測，先核對基準與單位，再依本步判別量測定位原因；不能只調參到曲線相合。
steps.failureEn: Incorrect hypothesis to reject: Optical data transmission eliminates electromagnetic emissions. If observations disagree, first check references and units, then use this step's discriminating measurement; do not simply tune parameters until curves agree.
steps.check: 提交返回路徑的量測判別表：標出跨平面走線、回流過孔與屏蔽接點，與近場掃描對照。 附上基準、重複性或不確定度，及不能由本資料判定的結論。
steps.checkEn: Submit a measurement-discrimination table for return paths: Map plane crossings, return vias and shield contacts against near-field scans. Include the reference, repeatability or uncertainty, and conclusions the data cannot support.
